basics.name: Rohit Gupta
basics.label: Senior Technical Writer
basics.summary: Senior Technical Writer with 16 years of experience driving documentation strategy and translating complex engineering concepts into high-impact user documentation, technical presentations, and customer communications. Skilled in structured authoring (DITA/XML), CMS management, and Docs-as-Code workflows in Agile product lifecycles.

work.name: FIS (Fidelity National Information Services)
work.summary: Managed end-to-end documentation for fintech SaaS products across sprint and release cycles.
highlights: Managed end-to-end documentation lifecycle including User Guides, Release Notes, and API guides aligned to sprint and release cycles for multiple products
Developed and executed cross-functional documentation roadmap that aligned content strategy with product owner objectives and UX goals
Restructured large sets of legacy documents into modular topic-based content, improving discoverability and maintainability
Reviewed AI-generated content and improved support efficiency, dropping incoming support tickets by 20% and speeding up answer times by 30%

work.name: L&T Technology Services (LTTS)
work.summary: Delivered structured technical documentation for heavy industry, oil and gas, and automotive clients.
highlights: Delivered structured technical documentation for heavy industry, oil and gas, and automotive clients using SME input and engineering source data across multiple concurrent projects
Led team of Technical Writers managing task allocation, project tracking, and quality review before client submission
Authored maintenance manuals, installation guides, Factory Acceptance Test documents, and Illustrated Parts Catalogs from CAD models and BOM data
Led migration projects to transition legacy documents to CMS platforms (Windchill and Enovia)

work.name: Delos Consulting
work.summary: Created technical documentation for aerospace clients.
highlights: Created Component Maintenance Manuals from engineering drawings, CAD models, and Bills of Materials for aerospace clients in ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D standards
Built foundational technical writing skills in engineering documentation, source-data analysis, and structured content development
